title: The sheaf Hom between coherent modules is coherent
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and $\mathcal F,\mathcal G$ coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules [pqf-def-coherent]. Then the sheaf Hom $\mathcal H=\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal G,\mathcal F)$ [def-pur-sheaf-hom] (taken on the site of open subsets of $X$: $\mathcal H(U)=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_U}(\mathcal G|_U,\mathcal F|_U)$) is a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module. (Stacks proves more: for any ringed space, $\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal G,\mathcal F)$ is locally the kernel of a map between finite direct sums of copies of $\mathcal F$ when $\mathcal G$ is of finite presentation, and is coherent when moreover $\mathcal F$ is coherent; a coherent $\mathcal G$ is of finite presentation, being of finite type with finite type kernels of all local maps $\mathcal O_U^{\oplus n}\to\mathcal G|_U$.)

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01CQ (lemma-internal-hom-locally-kernel-direct-sum, line 3739), 'in particular' clause; its proof cites the proof of Lemma 01CP (lemma-stalk-internal-hom) and Lemma 01BY (lemma-coherent-abelian); used in Cohomology of Schemes, proof of Lemma 0883 (lemma-fully-faithful)

proof.text: ($\mathcal G$ is locally finitely presented.) Let $x\in X$. Since $\mathcal G$ is of finite type [pqf-def-coherent] there are an open $U\ni x$ and a surjection $\psi:\mathcal O_U^{\oplus n}\to\mathcal G|_U$. By the second condition of coherence [pqf-def-coherent] the kernel $\mathcal K=\operatorname{Ker}\psi$ (sectionwise [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]) is of finite type, so there are an open $V$ with $x\in V\subseteq U$ and a surjection $\mathcal O_V^{\oplus m}\to\mathcal K|_V$. Since kernels are computed sectionwise, $\mathcal K|_V=\operatorname{Ker}(\psi|_V)$, and the composite $\mathcal O_V^{\oplus m}\to\mathcal K|_V\subseteq\mathcal O_V^{\oplus n}$ gives an exact sequence $\mathcal O_V^{\oplus m}\xrightarrow{a}\mathcal O_V^{\oplus n}\xrightarrow{\psi|_V}\mathcal G|_V\to0$ of $\mathcal O_V$-modules. Thus $X$ is covered by opens $V$ each carrying such a presentation of $\mathcal G|_V$.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01BW (lemma-coherent-finite-presentation, line 1596) and its proof, cited as 'finitely presented' in Lemma 01CQ

proof.text: (Restriction to $V$.) For an open $V\subseteq X$ the restriction $\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal G,\mathcal F)|_V$ equals $\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_V}(\mathcal G|_V,\mathcal F|_V)$ as $\mathcal O_V$-modules: by the definition of the sheaf Hom [def-pur-sheaf-hom] both have as sections over an open $W\subseteq V$ the $\mathcal O_W$-module $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_W}(\mathcal G|_W,\mathcal F|_W)$, with the same restriction maps and the same module structure.

source.place: Section 04TT (sites-modules-section-internal-hom), definition of the internal Hom and its restriction to a localized site (Lemma 0E8H, lemma-internal-hom-restriction, line 3775)

proof.text: (Locally a kernel.) Let $V$ be as in step 1, with the presentation $\mathcal O_V^{\oplus m}\xrightarrow{a}\mathcal O_V^{\oplus n}\to\mathcal G|_V\to0$. Applying [lem-weil-pbc-sheaf-hom-finite-presentation-kernel] on the ringed space $(V,\mathcal O_V)$ with $\mathcal H=\mathcal G|_V$ and $\mathcal M=\mathcal F|_V$ gives an exact sequence $0\to\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_V}(\mathcal G|_V,\mathcal F|_V)\to(\mathcal F|_V)^{\oplus n}\xrightarrow{\alpha}(\mathcal F|_V)^{\oplus m}$ of $\mathcal O_V$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Hence, by step 2, $\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal G,\mathcal F)|_V\cong\operatorname{Ker}(\alpha)$, a kernel of a map between finite direct sums of copies of $\mathcal F|_V$.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01CQ (lemma-internal-hom-locally-kernel-direct-sum, line 3739), first assertion, proved in the proof of Lemma 01CP (lemma-stalk-internal-hom, line 3619) via Lemma 01CO (lemma-internal-hom-exact)

proof.text: (Coherence on $V$.) $\mathcal F|_V$ is a coherent $\mathcal O_V$-module by [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-module-local-on-open-cover](1). Hence $(\mathcal F|_V)^{\oplus n}$ and $(\mathcal F|_V)^{\oplus m}$ are coherent and so is $\operatorname{Ker}(\alpha)$, by parts (3) and (1) of [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-modules-kernel-cokernel-sum] applied on the open subscheme $V$; by part (3) of the same node the isomorphic module $\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal G,\mathcal F)|_V$ is coherent.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01CQ, 'in particular' clause, whose proof cites Lemma 01BY (lemma-coherent-abelian, line 1641)

proof.text: (Gluing.) The opens $V$ of step 1 cover $X$ and $\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal G,\mathcal F)|_V$ is coherent for each of them (step 4), so $\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal G,\mathcal F)$ is a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module by [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-module-local-on-open-cover](2).
